intro: One address, read by the people who build MacroTrackr. There is no support tier and no ticket queue to climb.

channels.title: Email
channels.body: Anything at all: an account problem, a wrong number in a calculator, a refund, or a question before you sign up. Include what you were doing and what happened.

channels.title: Bug reports and feature requests
channels.body: Open an issue on GitHub. It is the fastest route for anything reproducible, and the discussion stays public so the next person with the same problem finds it.

channels.title: Security issues
channels.body: Email rather than opening an issue, so the report stays private until it is fixed. The security policy in the repository sets out what to include.

channels.title: Deleting your account or data
channels.body: You can do it yourself from Settings without asking anyone. If you would rather it was handled for you, email and it will be.

selfHostedNote: Running your own instance? Include your runtime profile, the platform you deployed on and any relevant logs. The self-hosting guide in the repository lists what is useful to send.
